dataSafety.isolatedServices: New disposable PostgreSQL and Redis; dedicated databases for regression and browser fixtures. External provider calls disabled or mocked.

dataSafety.historicalRecords: Price preparation does not rewrite stock, stock movements, costs, discounts or posted documents. Explicit inventory transfers still create their normal movements.

limitations: Existing duplicate cards and customer assortment directions are preserved; an administrator must review any intended data cleanup.
